limitations_and_boundaries: The study does not directly test the effect of myosin inhibition on regeneration due to potential indirect detrimental effects.
The causal role of actin organization is inferred from correlations and mechanical perturbations; direct molecular manipulation of actin alignment was not performed.
The study focuses on Hydra, and generalizability to other organisms is not addressed.
Sample sizes and replicate numbers are not explicitly reported for all experiments.
The wire anchoring experiment provides mechanical constraint but does not fully isolate the effect of actin alignment from other mechanical factors.
